old.title: Project Model configuration and safe available chat read API
old.description: Five Owner GET/HEAD resources only. The new HTTP representation limit is 8 MiB; it does not bound prior accepted database/library allocations or process RSS. Legal oversized results produce zero success projection; no array/item truncation or automatic smaller-limit retry. Existing System routes are unchanged.

new.title: Project Model configuration, commands and safe available chat API
new.description: Five accepted Owner GET/HEAD resources retain their two-second I/O and 8 MiB complete representation rules. Six configuration mutations and one explicit historical command lookup use the same current Project authority. Mutation publication/I/O budget is 30 seconds, lookup is two seconds; request JSON <=1 MiB and safe success output <=1 KiB. No Provider network invocation, credential material, new selector or Agent reference rewrite is provided.
